services.value: The CAChE Nutrient Analysis Core Facility provides NELAC-certified (E76930) and non-certified nutrient and water quality analyses, including dissolved nutrients, total phosphorus, total nitrogen, organic carbon (TOC/DOC), chlorophyll-a, and additional trace metal and tracer analyses. It also offers capabilities such as ion chromatography for cations and anions and additional equipment-based analyses including TOC/DOC analyzers, spectrofluorometers, UV-Vis spectrophotometers, and elemental/trace metal analyses.
